listing.name: God of War: Chains of Olympus — PSP Web Recomp (snuri00)
listing.original_game_title: God of War: Chains of Olympus
listing.summary: Two Ready at Dawn titles brought through combat; movies skipped; browser saves not directly interoperable with PSP encrypted saves. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PSP ISO or extracted disc; decrypted EBOOT via external PSP_DECRYPT; exact regional IDs not stated in README.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Local Linux setup.sh/port.sh/serve.sh compiles generated C++ to WASM from owned input and externally decrypted EBOOT; served browser player uses original disc data over HTTP Range. Native flag creates headless diagnostic runner.

warnings: Two Ready at Dawn titles brought through combat; movies skipped; browser saves not directly interoperable with PSP encrypted saves.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
